name: 答えの厳密さを選ぶ採点設定
prompt:
Create a faithful 390 × 590 px Japanese answer-grading settings component. Reference 1 is the authoritative Lighthouse native preview for exact Japanese copy, positions, typography, selected option and spacing. Return only this component canvas, without a phone frame or surrounding screen.

The user dislikes tint colors. Keep the entire canvas and all card interiors pure white #FFFFFF. Remove every mint, lavender, cream, gray, blue or other tinted surface fill, gradient, glow, shadow and texture. Preserve the large grading-card bounds and the smaller write-mode card bounds with their 12 px corners, using white fills and only a thin neutral #E5E5E5 outline for clear grouping. Keep all active radio details flat solid forest green #047857, unselected radio outlines neutral #6E6E6E on white, inactive toggle tracks neutral #E4E4E4 with white knobs, primary text #1D1D1D and explanatory text #6E6E6E.

Match the native 390×590 layout exactly. Main rounded card x=16/y=4, 358×420, 12 px corners, white fill and thin neutral outline. Heading “答えの判定方法” x=32/y=18, 326×16, Meiryo Bold 12/16, #1D1D1D.

Option 1 label “意味が合っていれば正解” x=32/y=56, 284×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, #1D1D1D. Unselected radio x=338/y=58, 18×18, white fill, 1 px neutral #6E6E6E outline. Description at x=32/y=90, 326×32, Meiryo Regular 12/16, #6E6E6E, exact two lines: “意味が同じ言い換えや、少しの入力ミスも” / “正解として扱います。”

Option 2 label “ほぼ同じ表現なら正解” x=32/y=162, 284×24; unselected radio x=338/y=164, 18×18, same neutral outline and white fill. Description x=32/y=196, 326×32, Meiryo Regular 12/16, #6E6E6E, exact lines: “つづりは合わせます。小さな句読点や” / “アクセントの違いは許容します。”

Option 3 label “完全に一致したら正解” x=32/y=268, 284×24. Selected radio x=338/y=270, 18×18, white fill with 1 px #047857 outline; centered solid #047857 dot x=342/y=274, 10×10. Description x=32/y=302, 326×32, Meiryo Regular 12/16, #6E6E6E, exact lines: “句読点や大文字・小文字などの違いも” / “含め、登録した答えと照合します。”

Row “正解を書き直す” x=32/y=368, 252×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24. OFF switch x=298/y=366, 54×30, neutral #E4E4E4 pill track, white 22×22 knob x=302/y=370, 11 px corners.

Below the large card, outside its border, place the exact explanatory lines at x=32/y=438 in a 326×32 box, Meiryo Regular 12/16, #6E6E6E: “間違えた問題では正解を入力してから、” / “次の問題に進みます。記述問題で使えます。”

Second rounded card x=16/y=500, 358×58, 12 px corners, white fill and thin neutral outline. Label “記述モード” x=32/y=518, 284×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24, #1D1D1D. Right chevron “〉” x=338/y=518 in a 20×24 box, Meiryo Regular 14/24, #6E6E6E. Preserve every line break, position, state and white gap; add no other content or decoration.
reviewNotes: White card surfaces and neutral outlines remove the tint fills; selected grading mode and disabled toggle match native state. Awaiting owner review.
